log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Lead Klefki screens + Dragonite Tailwind/Breaking Swipe to blunt special attackers and Sand Rush Excadrill/Tyranitar. Back Arcanine Intimidate/WoW/Flare Blitz is only reliable answer to Gholdengo and Excadrill, Aggron resists Fairy and Steel and hits Floette with Iron Head and Tyranitar with Body Press.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Floette-Mega Timid Fairy Aura Moonblast/Psychic/DGleam/Protect Floettite, Gholdengo Modest Occa GoodAsGold MakeItRain/ShadowBall/FocusBlast/Protect, Tyranitar Adamant Chople SandStream RockSlide/Crunch/LowKick/Protect, Excadrill Adamant LO SandRush EQ/IronHead/RockSlide/Protect, Rotom-Heat Timid Leftovers Levitate Tbolt/Overheat/WoW/Protect, Sinistcha Bold Sitrus Heatproof RagePowder/StrengthSap/MatchaGotcha/Protect. Us: Sneasler Jolly Unburden Sitrus FakeOut/CC/PoisonJab/Protect, Klefki Bold LightClay Prankster Reflect/LightScreen/TWave/DGleam, Dragonite Adamant Sash Multiscale Tailwind/ESpeed/BreakingSwipe/Protect, Arcanine Timid Leftovers Intimidate FlareBlitz/WoW/ESpeed/Protect, Aggron Careful Shuca Sturdy IronHead/RockSlide/BodyPress/Protect, Rotom-Mow Scarf Levitate LeafStorm/Tbolt/VoltSwitch/Protect. Gholdengo immune to FakeOut Normal and BodyPress Fighting and blocks Prankster status. Need Fire for Gholdengo. Screens+Tailwind core vs sand.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo leads as the wincon (immune to all of Sneasler's moves, blocks Klefki's T-Wave, resists Gleam) with Tyranitar to snap sand up. Sand Rush Excadrill then outruns even Tailwind teams and 4x-OHKOs Aggron, plus SE Ground/Steel on Klefki and Rock Slide on Dragonite/Arcanine. Rotom-Heat is the Levitate partner that lets Excadrill spam Earthquake freely, Overheats Klefki/Aggron (93.9-178.8% on Klefki), Tbolts Dragonite, and burns their physical attackers. Skipping Mega Floette since Fairy Aura
decisions.notebook:
OPPONENT ROSTER (open sheet): Sneasler (Jolly, Sitrus, Unburden; FakeOut/CC/PoisonJab/Protect), Klefki (Bold, LightClay, Prankster; Reflect/LightScreen/TWave/Gleam), Rotom-Mow (Timid, Scarf; LeafStorm/Tbolt/VoltSwitch/Protect), Dragonite (Adamant, Sash, Multiscale; Tailwind/ESpeed/BreakingSwipe/Protect), Arcanine (Timid, Lefties, Intimidate; FlareBlitz/WoW/ESpeed/Protect), Aggron (Careful, Shuca, Sturdy; IronHead/RockSlide/BodyPress/Protect).
OPP STYLE: Protect-spams Sneasler/Aggron into consecutive failures; Dragonite leads Tailwind off Sash; Klefki cycles in for screens. Attack the turn AFTER a successful Protect.
STRUCTURAL: Gholdengo hard-walls Sneasler (Normal/Fighting/Poison all 0x or blocked), Klefki (Gleam 0.5x, TWave blocked), Aggron Body Press. Only Arcanine/Rotom-Mow threaten it; Occa buys one Fire hit. Struggle is typeless and DOES hit it.
VERIFIED: Gholdengo SpA203 Focus Blast vs Aggron 170-339%; -2 SpA under Light Screen 43-85%. Aggron Iron Head vs Gholdengo 12.9-23.5%. Excadrill LO EQ vs Aggron (spread) 111.9-188% = OHKO through Shuca. Rotom-Heat Overheat vs Klefki 93.9-178.8%. Sneasler CC vs Tyranitar 168-240% (Chople still ~84-120%) - NEVER leave TTar in front of Sneasler; Aggron Body Press is 4x too. Use TTar only to set sand then pivot.
PLANS: (1) Never Make It Rain unless it wins on the spot (-2 SpA permanent). (2) Excadrill in sand = 232 Spe, outruns Tailwind; it is the Aggron/Klefki answer. (3) Keep Rotom-Heat paired with Excadrill so EQ is free (Levitate). (4) KO Klefki before screens; WoW/burn their physical attackers. (5) Mega Floette unused: Fairy

decisions.rationale: Reflect first via Prankster halves Rock Slide that threatens Dragonite (2x) and helps vs Excadrill later. Tailwind needed to outspeed Sand Rush Excadrill and Timid Floette. Multiscale+Sash keeps Dragonite alive through MakeItRain+RockSlide spread, with Reflect reducing physical portion.

Gholdengo blocks Prankster status and Normal/Fighting. Need Fire coverage. Screens+Tailwind core vs sand.

decisions.rationale: Corrected: Focus Blast is only neutral on Klefki (Fighting 0.5x into Fairy), so Shadow Ball does identical damage at 100% accuracy. Shadow Ball (40.9-77.3%) plus Rock Slide chip (12.2-23.5%) can outright KO the screen-setter, while Rock Slide simultaneously hits Dragonite 2x (~22-40% through Multiscale) with double flinch chance. Sandstorm also strips Multiscale via residual damage. TWave from Prankster Klefki can only touch Tyranitar, which is a planned pivot anyway.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Dragonite)
decisions.rationale: Klefki sets Light Screen before Gholdengo Shadow Ball due to Tailwind+Prankster, halving special damage and possibly surviving at 35%. Dragonite is faster than Tyranitar and Breaking Swipe first lowers its Attack, stacking with Reflect to make Rock Slide safe. Keeps screens up for Arcanine/Aggron follow-up.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine > Aggron here. Intimidate stacks to -2 Atk with Breaking Swipe, neuters Tyranitar Rock Slide under Reflect, resists Gholdengo Make It Rain, and threatens SE Flare Blitz vs Gholdengo. Aggron is 4x weak to Focus Blast/Low Kick on this board.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball is a clean KO on Klefki at 35% (special, unaffected by Reflect), removing the screen/Thunder Wave engine before Light Screen goes up. Tyranitar Rock Slide is the best remaining chip: super effective on Dragonite whose Multiscale is already broken and Sash irrelevant (~22-40% through Reflect), plus flinch equity, and it also finishes Klefki if Shadow Ball somehow underrolls. Keeps Sand Stream up for Excadrill later; Tyranitar can retreat next turn if Sneasler comes in.

Meanwhile Rotom Thunderbolt chips Arcanine ~21-40% through Light Screen with its -1 SpD, leaving it in Shadow Ball KO range next turn once Tailwind lapses. Attacking with Gholdengo instead just trades it away without securing the KO.

Dragonite Extreme Speed vs Rotom is 24-46% max, best odds to KO 36% Rotom. Screens reduce incoming special damage, making double KO attempt optimal before Arcanine faints.
